title: Modality Misalignment and Originality Attribution in Short-Form Video — Aditya Gautam, Meta
talk_summary: Meta's short-form video trust pipeline uses a centralized reviewer/orchestrator agent that delegates to a perceiver (VLM video decomposition) and retriever (multi-index similarity search) agent, each powered by small domain-fine-tuned/distilled VLMs. The transferable core is not the video ML but the operational patterns: cheap metadata pre-filtering to skip the expensive pipeline, caching/skipping on high-similarity repeats, per-node evaluation with adaptive reasoning budgets, and a production-sampling + LLM-judge + human-queue loop for continuous improvement.

takeaways.technique: Metadata pre-filtering to skip expensive pipeline
takeaways.what_they_do: Before running the full multi-agent pipeline, they use cheap metadata signals (creator authenticity score, topic, engagement, quality flags) to prune candidates that don't need deep processing.
When incoming content has a high similarity score to already-processed content (e.g. viral repeats), they skip the whole multi-agent system and reuse the prior decision.

takeaways.technique: Per-node evaluation with adaptive reasoning budget
takeaways.what_they_do: They evaluate not just end-task precision/recall but each node's retrieval recall, latency, and chain-of-thought quality, and tune reasoning budget up/down per node based on whether it's overthinking or underperforming.

takeaways.technique: Production sampling + LLM-judge + human queue loop
takeaways.what_they_do: They sample production inferences, score them with an in-house LLM judge trained on human labels, and route low-scoring traces (full agent/LLM/tool traces) to a human queue to localize whether the failure was reasoning, tool call, or retrieval.

takeaways.technique: Centralized orchestrator with specialized sub-agents and re-retrieval loop
takeaways.what_they_do: A reviewer/orchestrator decomposes the task, calls a perceiver for structured evidence and a retriever for similar cases, then decides whether to re-query the retriever before judging — sub-agents emit structured JSON metadata rather than raw content.

takeaways.technique: Distill/quantize frontier model into small domain model with size/quant table
takeaways.what_they_do: For a narrow internal task they distill (off/on-policy) and quantize frontier models into small specialized models, then keep a table of distillation/quantization sizes to pick the cheapest variant that still meets the quality bar.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I really don't care if the model can solve a coding problem. I only care about my domain specific problem
